tests/sdkcheck/msr_codegen_test.cpp and msr_native.cpp: compile synthetic mtmsrd L=1 and mfmsr through production AOT and execute 80 state/readback checks; baseline loses RI and overwrites IR, corrected output preserves unrelated bits and balances runtime interrupt locks.

tests/sdkcheck/system_heap_layout_test.cpp: shared first-fit holes, committed/protected metadata, zeroed reuse, free page accounting, unchanged physical allocation and retained system capacity after ordinary-range exhaustion; refined private runtime passes 357 assertions in 14 allocator/import/dispatch cases.

tests/sdkcheck/late_callback_discovery_test.cpp: rescan constructors found by gap fill, promote referenced speculative entries, verify generated registration, reject source clobber, conditional predecessors and metadata/config ownership; focused gap/CTR/emission controls.

tests/sdkcheck/shared_tail_entry_test.cpp: long/short shared tails inside speculative or inferred wrappers, generated registration and tail-call emission, invalid predecessors/targets, source clobber and declared extent controls; 108 assertions plus focused discovery/emission controls.

tests/sdkcheck/split_default_switch_test.cpp and split_default_switch_native.cpp: 643-slot switch with unsigned branch-over-default guard, CR/condition/edge/index/dominance controls, and all 65536 16-bit indices executed through real compiled AOT; heuristic scan limit unchanged.
sdkcheck.Vulkan-driver-pipeline-cache: real Vulkan depth-only guest draw; base rejects uncached creation, patched driver cache used. Existing predicated fetch acceptance/rejection remains checked.

sdkcheck.memexport-readback-contract: 13 assertions in 3 cases passed Release. GPU MEMEXPORT probes passed D3D12 fast/full and Vulkan fast/full on RTX 4070. Final baseline red D3D12 fast iteration 1 and Vulkan full concurrent iteration 0; candidate preserves non-exported CPU bytes with same real guest shader. Vulkan full eight distinct streams allocate no additional staging after first draw. All five applied LF files match staged bytes.

sdkcheck.vulkan-depth-bias: 65 assertions in 3 cases passed Release. Opt-in x360n_vulkan_depth_bias_gpu on RTX 4070: correct 24/24 exact (D32 float24 and D24, both signs, high/low depth, reversed viewports); legacy control 18/24 exact failures; fallback device without optional features keeps the legacy command. All eight applied files match the staged tested bytes.

sdkcheck achievement toast cases in x360n_sdk_runtime_checks: 227 assertions in 5 cases passed Release three consecutive runs (idle drawer list empty, one coalesced wake for four concurrent producers with full 4.5 s display per event, shutdown cancels queued wakes, push during detachment, UI-thread callback ownership). Baseline control fails: the idle toast keeps the ImGui dialog list non-empty. Patched rex_app.cpp compiled. All five applied files match the staged tested bytes.

tests/sdkcheck/system_heap_layout_test.cpp: top-down 4 KiB and 64 KiB allocations end exactly at 0x30000000/0x70000000, 64 KiB-aligned, page above free; baseline fails with 2FD01000 and 70000000 (5 assertions). Patched Release: 55 assertions in 4 system-heap-layout cases, 594 assertions in 20 focused allocator/import/dispatch cases, SDK unit_tests [heap],[memory] 173 assertions in 24 cases. Rebuilt dash_17559 session passed the boot intro (export 1 returned 0) without the 30001002 access violation.

tests/sdkcheck/adjacent_referenced_entry_test.cpp: two PDATA-less mfmsr/mtmsrd + lwarx/stwcx. adjusters ending in bctr, named only from .rdata; the second (0x82010078) is an entry and registered, controls with an undecodable word or PDATA-owned bytes stay unregistered. Skate 3 default.xex analysis registers 8246CED8 (0x38 bytes) after GapFill; the region-bounded baseline did not.

llvm.why: ReXGlue v0.10.0 CMakeLists.txt rejects non-Clang compilers and Clang < 18; official win-amd64 CI installs upstream LLVM. 22.1.8 was the newest stable LLVM when v0.10.0 was tagged (2026-08-21).

llvm_windows_arm64.why: Same LLVM release as llvm, native Windows ARM64 host build (GitHub release asset digest); selected on ARM64 Windows hosts.

msvc.note: Not downloaded. Clang targets x86_64-pc-windows-msvc and uses the installed MSVC STL/CRT and Windows SDK through vcvars64.bat.
